name: How long does it take to see results after fixing crawlability issues?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results after fixing crawlability issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to see results after fixing crawlability issues can vary. For critical fixes on high-priority pages, search engines might recrawl and reindex within days, especially if you request re-indexing in Google Search Console. However, for a site-wide impact on many pages or more complex issues, it could take several weeks to a few months for search engines to fully process the changes and reflect them in rankings. Continuous monitoring of crawl stats and search performance is essential during this period.
acceptedAnswer.description: Results can be seen within days for critical fixes, especially with re-indexing requests. Site-wide impacts or complex issues may take several weeks to a few months to fully reflect in search rankings.
